purpose: Subset used to measure the two R-09 mitigations (docs/governance.md).

rule.failures: every ticket the baseline auto-answered whose label says escalate
rule.controls: 10 of the 36 correctly auto-answered tickets, random.seed(7)

materialise: python -c "import json;ids=set(sum((json.load(open('evaluation/results/r09_subset_ids.json'))[k] for k in ('failures','controls')),[]));json.dump([t for t in json.load(open('data/validation_tickets.json')) if t['ticket_id'] in ids],open('/tmp/r09_subset.json','w'))"
